collection.description: A rare beetle's secretion cleans tarnished metal, and a jeweler wants to keep hundreds.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A rare beetle leaves a secretion that cleans tarnished metal remarkably well. A jeweler wants to keep hundreds.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The jeweler learns their habitat and collects no secretion.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The beetles may fail to thrive; the jeweler learns husbandry is not simple.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: More work is required, but the rare population is left alone.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: The method is slow but does not require capturing beetles.

b__text.name: Answer B
b__text.text: The method is slow but does not require capturing beetles.
